title: Concept: Repository reusing the central id
description: pom.xml declares a `<repository>` whose id shadows `central`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `<repository>` whose id shadows `central`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `<repository>` whose id shadows `central`.
